args.sql: SELECT t.account, c.name, ROUND(SUM(t.amount-t.settled)-c.credit_max,2) AS over_limit FROM erp_cust_trans t JOIN erp_customers c ON c.account=t.account WHERE t.txn_type='Invoice' AND t.closed=0 AND c.customer_group='90' GROUP BY t.account HAVING SUM(t.amount-t.settled) > c.credit_max ORDER BY over_limit DESC LIMIT 10
